notation usage target

  • CURIE: gmeow:notationUsageTarget
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationUsageTarget
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notation

The entity that uses the notation system — a language, lexical form, expression, work, or information object. Functional per relator: one target per NotationSystemUsage.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NotationSystemUsage -> gmeow:Entity; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:observedFeature

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:notationUsageTarget from gmeow:NotationSystemUsage to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
